condition: Infective colitis with bloody diarrhoea (possible STEC)
summary: 24-year-old man with three days of fever, cramps and bloody diarrhoea after a barbecue. IDSA 2017: stool culture including STEC/Shiga toxin; avoid antimotility agents and empirical antibiotics until STEC is excluded (HUS risk); first presentation of IBD is the differential.

inputs.hpi: Three days of watery then bloody diarrhoea 8 times a day with cramping lower abdominal pain and fever. Ate undercooked burgers at a barbecue 4 days before; a friend is also unwell. No previous bowel problems. No antibiotics recently. Took loperamide from the pharmacy.

exam.general: Dry mucous membranes. T 38.4°C, HR 102, BP 118/70.
exam.abdomen: Soft, diffusely tender in the lower abdomen, no guarding.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Acute infective colitis (bloody diarrhoea), STEC not excluded
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Acute bloody diarrhoea with fever after undercooked beef: infective colitis, STEC/E. coli O157 not excluded. Stool culture and Shiga toxin testing; stop loperamide; no empirical antibiotics until STEC excluded; monitor renal function and platelets.

mustNotMiss.knownGapNote: IBD is not in the PANE top 3 (the "Change in bowel habit" template has no CC hint).

mustInclude.note: IDSA 2017: bloody diarrhoea with fever → stool testing including STEC; results change antibiotic decisions.

mustExclude.note: Infective colitis is not a surgical abdomen: an emergency appendicectomy plan is a contraindicated operation. The exam text records "no guarding".
mustExclude.knownGapNote: Web computeClinicalPrompts fires "Appendicitis — emergency surgical indication" and adds the full "LAPAROSCOPIC APPENDICECTOMY — OPERATIVE PLAN" whenever examAbdomen contains "guarding" or "rebound" — including negated text ("no guarding") and localised guarding from other causes.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Gate the appendicectomy operative-plan prompt on the confirmed working diagnosis (appendicitis) or imaging, not on the words "guarding"/"rebound"; add negation handling (no/without/absent) to exam() matching.

mustExclude.note: Antimotility agents are avoided in bloody/inflammatory diarrhoea (toxic megacolon; HUS with STEC).
IDSA 2017: avoid antibiotics when STEC is possible (increased HUS risk).
mustExclude.knownGapNote: The appendicectomy operative-plan prompt adds "IV Pip-Tazo + metronidazole" (see mgmt-no-appendicectomy).

guideline.name: IDSA clinical practice guidelines — diagnosis and management of infectious diarrhoea
guideline.section: Bloody diarrhoea/fever: stool culture and STEC testing; avoid antimotility agents in inflammatory diarrhoea; avoid antibiotics in STEC O157/Shiga toxin 2 infection
guideline.citation: Shane AL, Mody RK, Crump JA, et al. 2017 Infectious Diseases Society of America clinical practice guidelines for the diagnosis and management of infectious diarrhea. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;65:e45–e80.

rationale: Base infective mimic of IBD and ischaemic colitis. The patient has self-started loperamide; the plan should stop it.
